headline: Forest’s chance volume goes unrewarded in Ipswich draw

sentences.text: Ipswich Town and Nottingham Forest shared a 1–1 draw, but the underlying numbers tilted heavily toward Forest: 2.29 xG to 0.46 and 17 shots to 7.
Forest also led 5–3 in shots on target and created 2 big chances to Ipswich’s 1, while possession was nearly even at 50.6% to 49.4%.
The result leaves Ipswich 9th on 10 points and Forest 16th on 6 after 8 matches.
